dialogues.speaker: Caholom
dialogues.text: Good day, I'm the high priest of the Masters of the Night-Wind. Can I help you with something?

dialogues.speaker: Caholom
dialogues.text: Ah, please don't expect too much from this title. Here, a high priest is just a priest with more experience.

dialogues.speaker: Caholom
dialogues.text: There's more than one high priest, and "high" does not refer to any kind of status or ability.

dialogues.speaker: Caholom
dialogues.text: ...Sorry, I don't mean to shirk any responsibility by saying this. I'm just doing this in hopes that visitors will get a general understanding of our tribe.

dialogues.speaker: Caholom
dialogues.text: Well, let's get back on track. Come see me if you need any help from us.

dialogues.speaker: Caholom
dialogues.text: So you're the one the prophecies spoke of. Welcome back once again to the Obsidian Altar.

dialogues.speaker: Caholom
dialogues.text: Please relax and stretch your legs, just as you would when you travel the world.

dialogues.speaker: Caholom
dialogues.text: Our tribesfolk don't often engage proactively with foreigners, so you might earn yourself quite a few curious looks.

dialogues.speaker: Caholom
dialogues.text: But please don't worry — we might know a few "tricks" that are difficult for foreigners to get, but trust me, we do not have any line-of-sight hexes or things like that.
